I am an old woman now, seventy years, and my hands know these beans since I was a small girl. On this small piece I planted beans mixed with a little maize like my mother showed me, and I use the cow manure from my neighbor's kraal because I have no money for the fertilizer in the bags — that is for the rich farmers in town. I keep my own seeds from last harvest, the ones that did well, and I weed with my own hands and my daughter helps me when she comes. The rains here in Mbeya are good, God willing, so I do not need to carry water.
